working_memory.overall: Primary contrast nominal significant; conservative Holm not; CV-corrected not; biomarker supported

fluid_intelligence.overall: Task-selective null. MS-A-NCR does not improve Fluid Intelligence prediction.

does_benefit_track_prior_signal: WM shows positive FC residual enrichment and positive A3-A4 prediction gain. Fluid Intelligence has not been audited for prior signal enrichment under the corrected solver. The observed task-specificity suggests the current Fluid prior may not capture task-relevant connectivity patterns, or the WM prior signal is stronger. No causal claim is made about prior signal magnitude predicting method benefit.
recommended_paper_wording: MS-A-NCR improved Working Memory prediction (Δr = ..., p = ...) but not Fluid Intelligence (Δr = ..., 3 seeds). This task specificity is consistent with the hypothesis that the effectiveness of connectome-informed priors depends on the degree to which task-relevant connectivity patterns are captured by the external prior.
